# Context Pack: `durable-operation-spine` — App durable operation spine

Target: ultraplan-go @ 50d6f0d25ff273f4cb956f11e6030376108110bc (working tree clean except untracked `.ultraplan/`).
Planning context: ultraplan-workspace @ ab12dc38059c9bf485f9aced9075bcd7d924cac5.
Domain: durability-core. Risk: critical. Descriptive only — no defect judgments.

## 1. Purpose

`internal/app` owns the single accept-before-execute chokepoint shared by CLI, TUI, and web: before any runtime-backed work starts, the operation is durably accepted and claimed in `.ultraplan/run-control.db`, and every observable event is committed to that store before it is delivered to any live consumer. Two run tiers exist: OUTER "operation" runs (`Target.Kind="operation"`, one per user-visible operation, managed by `durableOperationManager`) and INNER "runtime" runs (one per agentwrap/OpenCode `StartRun`, managed by `controlledRuntime`), correlated via `Correlation.ProductRunID = ParentRun(ctx)` — the outer context carries its RunID via `runcontrol.WithParentRun` (runcontrol/context.go:7-25). The spine also mints the QA writer-token handoff that lets sprint code fence its private state writes on the outer run's lease. Storage mechanics (accept/claim/append/heartbeat/terminal/reconcile SQL) belong to surface `run-journal-fencing`; this pack covers the app-layer behavior built on top.

## 2. Entrypoints and control flow

### 2.1 Process wiring (`run_control.go:23-95`)
`newRunControlState()` (:32) mints ONE process owner (`currentRunOwner` → `runcontrol.NewProcessOwner`) at CLI start; `dependencies.runControl` holds it for the whole process (app.go:108-124, :189-200). `runControlState.repository(ctx, root, policies...)` (:37-75) caches one SQLiteRepository + LocalFileLogger + retention policy per workspace root; a cached repository with a DIFFERENT policy errors ("retention policy changed during the process lifetime", :47-49); first open runs startup `Reconcile` and fails closed (:66-70). `Close()` (:77-91) closes pools/loggers during process shutdown. Retention policy derived from config with ignored parse errors (`runControlRetentionPolicy` :153-157). `controlledRuntimeFor` (:140-151) resolves the cached repository and wraps any `StartRun`-shaped base runtime in a `controlledRuntime` carrying repository+owner. Used by `sprintRuntimeService` (sprint_commands.go:685-707, injected via `WithRuntime(controlled, req)`), study `runLoopService`/`runAllService`/`executionService` (study_commands.go:338, :695, :873).

### 2.2 Outer accept — `durableOperationManager.AcceptOperation` (durable_operations.go:97-138)
Input: `Confirmation` (normally produced by `PrepareOperation`, operations.go:211-359) + caller-supplied digest string. Sequence: build `Target{Kind:"operation", Operation=string(req.Kind), Project/Sprint/Study/Stage/Task}` → `repository.Accept(Acceptance{ProductStatus:"prepared", OperationAlias:digest, ConfirmationDigest:digest})` (:103-105). On `ErrConflict` WITH non-empty digest only: resolve alias → return `{RunID, Context: caller ctx unchanged, Existing:true, Lifecycle}` (:106-112) — no claim, no fence, no ownership. Any other Accept error fails closed (:113-115). Then `Claim{Lease: OwnerLeaseDuration=15s}` (:116-119), fence assembled from attempt (:120), first `lifecycle=running` append via `appendRunEventWithRetry`; if THAT fails, proposes `TerminalPersistenceLost` ("operation start persistence failed") on a detached 30 s context using the just-minted fence BEFORE returning the error (:121-129). Success path: `operationCtx = WithCancel(WithParentRun(ctx, RunID))` plus a context value `durableOperationOwnership{repository, fence}` (:130-131); ownership stored in per-instance map `m.owned[RunID]` (:132-135); control goroutine spawned (:136); returns `{RunID, Context: operationCtx, Lifecycle:"running"}`.

### 2.3 QA writer-token handoff (`qaOwnershipFromContext` :140-156)
Extracts `durableOperationOwnership` from ctx; builds `sprint.QAWriterToken{RunID, OperationalAttemptID, FencingGeneration}` (sprint/qa_types.go:179-191) plus a fence closure: full struct equality against the minted token else `ErrStaleFence` (:147-149); on match performs `repository.Heartbeat(context.WithTimeout(context.WithoutCancel(ctx), 30s), fence, 15s lease)` (:150-153) — heartbeating survives outer-context cancellation for bounded post-run writes. Consumers: `durableCLICommand.QAWriterToken()` (:64-69) used by `sprint qa run/resume` (sprint_commands.go:419-442: token+fence → `WithQAWriterFence(fence)` → `RunQA(durable.Context(), ...)`); and `sharedOperationRunner` OperationQAStart/QAResume reads the SAME context value from the accepted operation ctx (operation_runner.go:114-130). Sprint side: `checkWriter` requires a configured fence before every QA publish (sprint/qa_state.go:453-465); without an installed fence sprint falls back to comparing against `req.WriterToken` (sprint/qa.go:260-267).

### 2.4 Event recording + coalescing (`RecordOperationEvent` :158-221)
Adapter emit callbacks call this with `context.Background()`. Unknown RunID → `(false, ErrNotFound)` (:162-164). Per-operation `eventMu` serializes: event type = progress, or warning when `State==OperationFailed` (:167-170); dedup key = concatenation of type/stage/task/phase-state/summary/event-type/kind/tool/reason/detail (:171); identical progress within `ProgressCoalesceWindow`=250 ms (measured against wall-clock `time.Now().UTC()`) increments an in-memory omission counter instead of appending (:174-181, returns `(false,nil)` so adapters ALSO suppress local display). Non-coalesced events build payload {state,type,count "done/total"} plus optional phase_state/summary/tool_*/provider/model/harness keys when non-empty (:182-195); pending coalesced count flushes into the draft's Omission metadata (:196-207); append via `appendRunEventWithRetry`; append error calls `owned.cancel()` and returns the error (:208-216); progress bookkeeping updated only after commit (:217-219).

### 2.5 Manager control goroutine (`controlOperation` :223-264)
1 s ticker (`OwnerTickInterval`, model.go:514): Snapshot poll (:235) — error ⇒ cancel+exit silently (:236-239); `CancellationRequested` ⇒ fenced `AcknowledgeCancellation` then cancel (:240-247); heartbeat every ≥5 s (`HeartbeatInterval`) (:248-254); `Reconcile` every ≥10 s (`ReconciliationInterval`) (:255-261). Any of these errors cancels and exits WITHOUT surfacing or persisting a diagnostic. Exit conditions: ctx done, `owned.stop` closed, or first tick error. `FinishOperation` joins via `owned.done`.

### 2.6 Finish + terminal mapping (`FinishOperation` :266-300)
Pops ownership under mutex (unknown id ⇒ nil, no-op success :267-273). Under `eventMu`: flush trailing coalesced omissions as an omission event; a flush failure becomes `runErr` only when no other error exists (:274-282). Then close(stop) → wait done → owned.cancel() (:283-285). Outcome mapping order (:286-297): `errors.Is(runErr, DeadlineExceeded)` → timed_out; `errors.Is(runErr, Canceled)` OR `state==cancelled` → cancelled; other `runErr != nil` OR `state==failed` → failed; `state==partial` → interrupted; default succeeded. Terminal proposed with retry on detached-or-bounded caller ctx (:298-299).

### 2.7 CLI envelope (`beginDurableCLICommand` :49-60, `durableCLICommand` :37-91, `finishDurableCLICommand` :86-91)
Resolves repository via `runRepository` (run_commands.go:42-59: workspace discover → config → cached repo), creates a FRESH manager per command over the shared process owner, accepts with EMPTY digest (`Confirmation{Request:request}` — CLI never runs PrepareOperation/fingerprints; durable_operations.go:55). `Context()` exposes the accepted ctx; product code runs inside it. `Finish(runErr)`: state = cancelled if `accepted.Context.Err()!=nil` (checked FIRST), else failed if runErr, else complete (:71-77); terminal proposal on a detached 30 s ctx (:78-83); accept failures exit classified `ExitRuntime` "run-control.accept". Callers: exactly 10 sites — sprint flow/verify/execute/qa-run-resume/review/smoke (sprint_commands.go:237, :292, :338, :419, :483, :539) and study resume/run-all/analysis/synthesis (study_commands.go:211, :555, :814, :843), each pairing with `finishDurableCLICommand` (errors.Join semantics). Pinned by source-inventory test (§10).

### 2.8 Inner runtime runs — `controlledRuntime.StartRun` (run_control.go:159-343)
Target from request (`targetFromRuntimeRequest` :392-415: Kind=PromptRef.OwnerKind else study/sprint/"runtime"; Operation=Purpose else stage/task-kind/prompt-id/"runtime"; project/sprint/study/stage/task from bounded metadata). Correlation: `{ProductRunID: bounded(ParentRun(ctx)), ProductTaskID: TraceID}` (:161-164) — set when running under an outer operation ctx; standalone inner runs correlate empty. Accept(ProductStatus "accepted") → Claim(with correlation) → fence (:165-182). `req.Metadata` cloned and stamped with `run_control_run_id` so child code can observe its durable id (:186-187). OnEvent REPLACED by a persistence gate (:204-249): suppressed once a persistence error exists (:206-209); builds sanitized `runtimeEventDraft` (:210, §2.9); content-hash coalescing — identical progress payloads (key = type\0stage\0task\0payloadHash; hash excludes runtime_event_id/runtime_run_id/session_id, :215-227, :730-752) within 250 ms measured against event time (zero → now) collapse into omission counters; pending counts ride the next committed draft (:228-236); `appendRunEventWithRetry` commits (:237-241); ONLY THEN does the original `configuredOnEvent(event)` fire (:246-248) — persistence-gated delivery. First append failure records `persistenceErr` (once) and cancels runCtx (:196-203, :237-241). Control goroutine (:251-301) mirrors §2.5 cadences but distinguishes shutdown (runCtx already canceled ⇒ silent return) from real failure (`setPersistenceErr` :263-298). `base.StartRun(runCtx, req)` executes the actual runtime work (:302). Afterwards under lock: trailing omission flush (:303-316); cancel(); join controlDone (:317-318). If persistenceErr: propose `TerminalPersistenceLost` ("durable event persistence failed") on detached 30 s ctx, join errors (:322-331). Else `terminalOutcome(result, runErr, parentCtx)` mapping (:765-777): timeout (DeadlineExceeded in runErr/parent, or result.Error.Category=="timeout") → timed_out; cancelled (Canceled in runErr/parent, status=="can... (line truncated to 2000 chars)

### 2.9 App-side sanitization pipeline (`runtimeEventDraft` :417-545)
Type mapping (:418-439): warning/warn/error→warning; artifact/file→artifact; finding→finding; message/text/output/*reasoning*/content/delta→message; kind-based fallback (message kinds visible as messages; tool kinds stay progress). Base payload identity {runtime_event_id, runtime_run_id, session_id, type, kind} (:440-446). Tool-kind events get structured observation capture (:447-449, `captureToolObservation` :624-653): nested alias search depth ≤5 (:655-684) for call-id/name/status plus JSON-encoded arguments/result/error passed through `redactObservableValue` (:686-715 — sensitive-key keys replaced "[REDACTED]"; strings containing bearer /sk-/ghp_/github_pat_/private-key markers wholly redacted). Generic payload loop (:454-520): denylist key filter (`isSensitivePayloadKey` :547-555: secret/token/password/authorization/cookie/api_key/apikey/credential/auth substrings), key normalization ≤128 B without NUL/CR/LF, one-level map flattening with promotion allowlist {tool,title,detail,text,delta,content,message,action,state,status,native_type,line} else `parent_child` namespacing, values stringified bounded ≤32 KiB (`boundedPayloadValue` :717-728 strips NUL/CR/LF, byte-truncates), payload capped at 30 entries; display keys re-extracted up to two nesting levels (:521-529, :557-574). Omission decision (:530-537): RawPresent/RawOmitted → reason-carrying omission Count=1; else if more input fields than persisted−5 → "runtime payload truncated to safe observable fields". Everything passes through the storage-side sanitizer afterwards (surface `run-journal-fencing` §6). Target/correlation fields bounded by `boundedSafe` (≤512 B, control chars stripped :787-798).

### 2.10 Retry helpers
`appendRunEventWithRetry` (:345-356): retries ≤5 s wall deadline on `ErrUnavailable|ErrBusy` only, sleeping ≤100 ms slices honoring ctx (:374-390). `proposeRunTerminalWithRetry` (:358-368): retries until success/non-retryable, 250 ms sleeps, bounded ONLY by caller ctx (callers pass 30 s detached contexts at :125, :323, :335; CLI finish :78; web/TUI finish 30 s; QA fence heartbeat 30 s).

### 2.11 Adapter acceptance regimes (three digests, one alias table)
- CLI: digest "" — no alias row written; every invocation accepts a fresh run; dedup impossible by design.
- TUI (tui/app.go:232-279): one manager per TUI session (tui_commands.go:52); digest = hex(sha256(CanonicalRequest + "\x00" + InputFingerprint)) of the on-screen Confirmation (:236-238); Existing → result card "matching durable operation already exists" with lifecycle-as-state (:243-249); otherwise opctx swapped for accepted.Context (:250-253); emit callback gates local display on RecordOperationEvent commit but SWALLOWS errors (:287-295); finish via manager on detached 30 s ctx joined into result error (:297-304).
- Web (web/operations.go:150-232): hub-level dedup map keyed by `confirmationDedupKey = sha256(sessionID + "\x00" + confirmationToken)` (web/security.go:448-451; operation_handlers.go:156, :351); draining/capacity gates first (:162-170); server re-confirms via consume(token) then `manager.AcceptOperation(ctx, prepared, dedupKey)` (:173-183); ErrWebUnavailable tolerated → degrades to in-memory op (:184-190); success substitutes the DURABLE RunID for the hub op id and adopts accepted.Context (:188-191); Existing → document with `DurableStatus.RefreshPath="/runs/<id>"` and lifecycle-as-state (:192-198). Hub `run` (:221-243): RunOperation with publish callback → `publishAppEvent` (:245-257) persists via RecordOperationEvent FIRST, drops coalesced (committed=false) and cancels the record on persist error, publishes SSE only after commit; FinishOperation on detached 30 s ctx joined into runErr (:233-239).
- Shared use-case guards: dashboard/web use cases return `ErrWebUnavailable` when the durable capability is absent (usecases.go:103-108, web_usecases.go:444-449).
- Fingerprint authority (TUI/web only): `PrepareOperation` clears transport-supplied `ExpectedFingerprint`, recomputes canonical JSON + sha256 over governed workspace inputs with symlink rejection (operations.go:211-359, :663-718); `RunOperation` re-verifies `expected == prepared.InputFingerprint` else `ErrStaleOperation` before execution (:376-386). Comment contract: fingerprints are "server-issued authority… never accepted from a caller" (operations.go:129-132); digests are "already non-reversible" (operations.go:38-41).

## 3. Inputs / outputs

Inputs: OperationRequest fields from transport adapters (normalized+validated in PrepareOperation; scope charset enforced operations.go:541-557); Confirmation with canonical request, governed-input fingerprint, scopes/warnings; caller digest strings ("" / TUI hash / web session+token hash); runtime requests (PromptRef, Metadata, Prompt, TraceID, OnEvent); runtime events (arbitrary provider-shaped maps — treated as untrusted, §2.9); config-derived retention policy and runtime factory; process-lifetime `deps.ctx`. Outputs: rows in `.ultraplan/run-control.db` via the shared repository (outer+inner runs, attempts, events, aliases); `AcceptedOperation{RunID, Context, Existing, Lifecycle}`; OperationEvents to adapters (SSE/TUI stream) gated on commit; `OperationResult` with typed error envelopes (operations.go:751-796); `QAWriterToken` + fence closure handed to sprint; injected `run_control_run_id` metadata into runtime requests; child execution delegated to base runtime (OpenCode network sessions — outside this surface); classified CLI exit codes (`ExitRuntime` on accept/finish failure).

## 4. Authoritative state

- Durable authority is `.ultraplan/run-control.db` (schema/ownership: surface `run-journal-fencing`). This surface WRITES: outer operation rows (Target.Kind="operation", ProductStatus "prepared"), claims with the single process owner, operation-scope events (progress/warning/lifecycle/omission/terminal), aliases named by adapter digest, terminal proposals. It READS: Snapshots (cancellation state, liveness) every 1 s per active run tier.
- In-memory, per-manager-instance: `m.owned[RunID]` {fence, cancel, stop/done channels, eventMu, coalescing state} (durable_operations.go:14-32); per-controlledRuntime closure state (eventMu, persistenceErr, coalescing state) (run_control.go:189-203).
- Process-wide: `runControlState` repositories/loggers/policies per workspace root + one Owner (run_control.go:23-30); managers created per command (CLI), per TUI session, or per serve process (serve_commands.go:81).
- Derived product state written THROUGH fences by sprint (QA state files) belongs to surface `sprint-qa-investigation`; the spine only guarantees heartbeat-backed fencing.

## 5. Invariants (as implemented)

- Accept-before-execute: no child runtime work begins until Accept+Claim(+first append for operations; Accept+Claim for runtime runs) succeed; acceptance-persistence failure prevents base.StartRun entirely (test-pinned, §10).
- Persistence-gated delivery: display/downstream callbacks fire only after the corresponding Append commits, in both spine variants (run_control.go:246-248; web publishAppEvent; TUI emit gating).
- One claim per run lifetime, one terminal winner, monotonic sequences: inherited from runcontrol CAS/fencing (dependency surface); this surface always operates through freshly minted per-attempt fences and never mutates rows directly.
- Fail-closed on persistence loss: mid-run append/heartbeat/poll/reconcile failure cancels the run context (work drains through cancellation) and ends in a `persistence_lost` terminal proposed on a detached context; start-time append failure terminalizes before returning.
- Coalescing never loses counts: collapsed duplicates accumulate into Omission {reason, count, first/last} carried by the next committed event or flushed at finish; committed=false also suppresses duplicate local display.
- Cancellation path: external request persisted (ownerless) → observed within ≤1 s tick → fenced AcknowledgeCancellation → local context cancel → product drains → terminal arbitration decides cancelled-vs-completed with single-winner guarantee.
- Detached-terminal discipline: every finish/terminal/QA-heartbeat write uses a fresh ≤30 s background context (`context.Background()`/`WithoutCancel`), so shutdown or run-context cancellation cannot prevent terminal commit; append retries are strictly 5 s-bounded.
- Single process owner: all claims of one process share Owner.ID; fencing generations distinguish attempts.
- Boundedness at the boundary: target fields ≤512 B, payload values ≤32 KiB, payload ≤30 entries, keys ≤128 B, control bytes stripped before storage validation sees them.
- Structural pinning: runtime-backed CLI entries must cross `beginDurableCLICommand` (inventory test, §10); TUI/web must go through `DurableOperationManager.AcceptOperation` (capability interface assertion pattern).

## 6. Trust boundaries

- Transport → server: `ExpectedFingerprint` stripped and recomputed server-side; stale fingerprint rejected before runner dispatch (operations.go:215, :376-386). Confirmation tokens consumed once server-side (web preparation store); dedup keys derived server-side from session+token (security.go:448-451). The digest persisted into `operation_aliases`/`confirmation_digest` is always the server-computed hash, never raw transport data.
- Runtime/provider events → durable store: untrusted maps pass the app-side pipeline (denylist keys, redaction markers, bounds, flattening caps, §2.9) AND the runcontrol storage sanitizer; dropped detail becomes Omission metadata, never silence.
- Context-carried capability: `durableOperationOwnership` (repository + fence) travels in context values; QA token equality (struct compare incl. generation) is the only check that a caller presenting a token owns the fence; possession of the ctx (or token) IS the authority.
- Workspace-local trust domain: any local process may open the same db and accept/claim/cancel; no authorization layer between adapters and repository (inherited posture from dependency surface).
- Child-process boundary: `run_control_run_id` metadata injection clones the caller's metadata map before mutation (run_control.go:186-187); prompt content itself is never persisted here (test-pinned "never persisted").

## 7. External effects & cancellation/retry/restart/error semantics

Effects: runcontrol db rows/WAL via shared pool; child runtime execution (network sessions, provider APIs — owned by platform/runtime surfaces); sprint/study/QA workspace file mutations triggered by product code running INSIDE accepted contexts; stdout/stderr presentation. No direct filesystem writes by this layer beyond what repository/logger do.

Acceptance failure ⇒ operation never exists beyond its accepted row (if any); CLI exits ExitRuntime; web handler surfaces error (unless degraded mode). Claim failure after successful Accept leaves an accepted-unclaimed row for reconciliation (grace 45 s — dependency surface). Start-append failure ⇒ persistence_lost terminal, start aborts. Mid-run persistence failure ⇒ runCtx cancel → base runtime observes cancellation → persistence_lost terminal; error joined into returned error (runtime tier) or implicit via context (operation tier). Restart/crash: abandoned outer runs keep leases expiring at 15 s; reconciliation (startup + periodic, dependency surface) terminalizes them interrupted/uncertain using birth identity; restarted work is a NEW run correlated by ParentRun/ProductRunID, never adopted. Shutdown: process Close() closes pools last; all terminal proposals ride detached contexts; web drain records cleanup-uncertain via separate capability (web_usecases.go:540-561 — adjacent seam).

## 8. Immediate surface dependencies

- `run-journal-fencing` (internal/runcontrol): ALL storage semantics (accept/claim/fence/CAS/terminal/reconciliation/quota/sanitizer); constants imported (model.go:508-519, :13); WithParentRun correlation helper.
- `shared-usecase-vocabulary`: three acceptance regimes converging on one alias table (seam three-acceptance-regimes-one-alias); DTO vocabulary in run_usecases/web_usecases.
- `run-cli-observation` + `web-operation-hub-sse`: consumers of the committed journal; replay loops duplicate cadence constants; hub substitutes durable ids (web/operations.go:188).
- `sprint-*` (esp. `sprint-qa-investigation`): consumes QAWriterToken/fence; sprint services execute inside accepted contexts via `sprintRuntimeService`; inner sprint runtime runs inherit ParentRun correlation.
- `study-runloop-scheduler`/`study-task-execution`: study services wrap controlledRuntime identically (study_commands.go:338/:695/:873).
- `process-execution` / `opencode-agent-runtime`: the wrapped base runtimes behind controlledRuntime.
- `config-inspection-health`: retention knobs feeding runControlRetentionPolicy; health commands read the same repository.
- `product-state-mirror`: second pool on same db file (no direct interaction from this layer).

## 9. Contracts (CURRENT-CONTRACT evidence)

TRD.md (workspace projects/ultraplan-go/docs): L396 mutating/runtime-backed work requires "a server-issued, short-lived confirmation bound to the normalized request and current governed-input fingerprint"; L2202 "Acceptance … is atomic with durable run creation and happens before child execution. If required acceptance persistence fails, the child does not start. Event records are redacted before persistence, assigned monotonically increasing per-run sequences, and committed before live fan-out"; L2223 + L2672 require safe fail-closed/degraded behavior for acceptance, mid-run append, heartbeat, terminal persistence failures; L2367 partial success must be detectable and recoverable; Sprint 35 requirements (sprints/35-durable-run-observability/requirements.md L24, L40-41): reconciliation never infers success; exactly one terminal outcome wins across races. Code-comment contracts: operations.go:129-132 (fingerprint server authority), :38-41 (non-reversible digest), operation_runner.go:15-17 (single runtime-backed implementation; adapters own presentation/confirmation only), durable_operations.go:34-36 (CLI counterpart keeps manager alive for whole command), runcontrol/context.go:7 (parent-run correlation).

## 10. Tests (evidence map)

App package (baseline green; review/baseline):
- run_control_test.go: forwards session deletion when base supports it (:25-34); accept→claim→commit-before-delivery incl. delivery callback reading exactly 1 committed event, parent correlation, sanitized journal with secret dropped + omission present + terminal second (:49-109); acceptance-persistence failure prevents child start (:111-129); runtime failure persisted as failed terminal without leaking error text (:131-157).
- durable_operations_test.go: full outer lifecycle accept→claim→ParentRun ctx→running snapshot→QA token/fence roundtrip incl. WithoutCancel cleanup fence and stale-generation rejection→record event (message omitted, tool/phase payload retained)→finish→succeeded LastSequence=3 (:11-90); cross-manager alias dedup Existing:true + closed-repository accept fails non-conflict (:92-124).
- run_tool_observability_test.go: tool arguments/result preserved redacted (:10); usage metrics not mistaken for tool IO (:35).
- run_control_inventory_test.go: pins beginDurableCLICommand counts (sprint 6, study 4) AND presence of each runtime-backed entry marker by counting source strings (:22-51).
- web_operations_test.go: prepare normalizes fingerprints/no side effects (:15); stale fingerprint rejected before runner (:59); QA prep rejects caller-owned controls (:148).
- Adapter tests: web operations_test/integration_test cover hub dedup, SSE shapes, degradation flags; tui_commands_test covers TUI wiring smoke.
Storage-side behaviors (claim races, reconcile matrix, fault injection) are pinned in internal/runcontrol tests (see sibling pack §10).

Coverage gaps noted factually: no test drives manager `controlOperation` tick paths (ack/heartbeat/reconcile branches) directly; no test covers RecordOperationEvent append-error → owned.cancel propagation end-to-end; web degrade-mode (durable nil) exercised only via fake capability absence in unit tests; no test pins TUI digest derivation or web confirmationDedupKey composition; no test covers FinishOperation omission-flush-failure outcome mapping.

## 11. Explicit unknowns / open questions (for later reviewers)

1. Ownership scoping asymmetry: alias dedup is repository-wide but `m.owned` is per-manager-instance; a different manager (or process) cannot finish/record for a run it did not accept (nil-op success / ErrNotFound). Cross-instance finishing relies solely on lease expiry + reconciliation.
2. Manager-tier tick failures (snapshot/ack/heartbeat/reconcile) cancel silently — no surfaced diagnostic, no persisted warning event, in contrast to the runtime tier's setPersistenceErr recording.
3. Two independent coalescing implementations with different key spaces (full tuple vs payload-hash) and different clocks (wall now vs event.Time fallback now); parity between them is unpinned.
4. `payloadHash` is plain concatenated string comparison despite the name; excludes exactly three identity keys.
5. `RecordOperationEvent`/finish-flush hold the per-operation mutex across Append including the 5 s retry window — serialization point per operation.
6. TUI emit swallows RecordOperationEvent errors (no display change, no local signal); internal owned.cancel still fires.
7. Alias-conflict Existing results carry the CALLER's ctx unchanged, no fence, possibly-terminal lifecycle; each adapter projects it differently (refresh path vs static card).
8. Start-append failure path terminalizes a run that executed nothing as persistence_lost — intended shape unstated.
9. Web degrade mode (durable capability absent) continues fully in-memory with hub-generated ids and NO persistence gating — designed fallback; which deployments hit it depends on wiring (serve always wires one today).
10. `deps.ctx` is process-lifetime; Ctrl-C/signal propagation into CLI operation contexts depends on cfg.Context wiring outside this surface.
11. Inventory pinning works by literal string-counting two specific files; new runtime-backed entry points elsewhere would not trip it unless added to the table.
12. `boundedSafe`/`boundedPayloadValue` truncate raw bytes (may split multi-byte runes) before storage-side validation.
13. QA fence equality is whole-struct comparison; token reuse across attempts fails only via generation mismatch — dependency on runcontrol's monotonic generation guarantee.
14. Abandoned-but-unfinshed outer operations (adapter crash between accept and finish) leave running rows until 15 s lease + grace reconciliation; no app-level sweeper exists.
15. `RecordOperationCleanupUncertain`/`ReconcileOperations` (web shutdown drain) write product-owned cleanup markers, not runcontrol rows — relationship to outer run terminals is defined only by convention.

— End of context pack. Descriptive only; no defect claims made or implied.

# Context Pack: `durable-operation-spine` — App durable operation spine

Target: ultraplan-go @ 50d6f0d25ff273f4cb956f11e6030376108110bc (working tree clean except untracked `.ultraplan/`).
Planning context: ultraplan-workspace @ ab12dc38059c9bf485f9aced9075bcd7d924cac5.
Domain: durability-core. Risk: critical. Descriptive only — no defect judgments.

## 1. Purpose

`internal/app` owns the single accept-before-execute chokepoint shared by CLI, TUI, and web: before any runtime-backed work starts, the operation is durably accepted and claimed in `.ultraplan/run-control.db`, and every observable event is committed to that store before it is delivered to any live consumer. Two run tiers exist: OUTER "operation" runs (`Target.Kind="operation"`, one per user-visible operation, managed by `durableOperationManager`) and INNER "runtime" runs (one per agentwrap/OpenCode `StartRun`, managed by `controlledRuntime`), correlated via `Correlation.ProductRunID = ParentRun(ctx)` — the outer context carries its RunID via `runcontrol.WithParentRun` (runcontrol/context.go:7-25). The spine also mints the QA writer-token handoff that lets sprint code fence its private state writes on the outer run's lease. Storage mechanics (accept/claim/append/heartbeat/terminal/reconcile SQL) belong to surface `run-journal-fencing`; this pack covers the app-layer behavior built on top.

## 2. Entrypoints and control flow

### 2.1 Process wiring (`run_control.go:23-95`)
`newRunControlState()` (:32) mints ONE process owner (`currentRunOwner` → `runcontrol.NewProcessOwner`) at CLI start; `dependencies.runControl` holds it for the whole process (app.go:108-124, :189-200). `runControlState.repository(ctx, root, policies...)` (:37-75) caches one SQLiteRepository + LocalFileLogger + retention policy per workspace root; a cached repository with a DIFFERENT policy errors ("retention policy changed during the process lifetime", :47-49); first open runs startup `Reconcile` and fails closed (:66-70). `Close()` (:77-91) closes pools/loggers during process shutdown. Retention policy derived from config with ignored parse errors (`runControlRetentionPolicy` :153-157). `controlledRuntimeFor` (:140-151) resolves the cached repository and wraps any `StartRun`-shaped base runtime in a `controlledRuntime` carrying repository+owner. Used by `sprintRuntimeService` (sprint_commands.go:685-707, injected via `WithRuntime(controlled, req)`), study `runLoopService`/`runAllService`/`executionService` (study_commands.go:338, :695, :873).

### 2.2 Outer accept — `durableOperationManager.AcceptOperation` (durable_operations.go:97-138)
Input: `Confirmation` (normally produced by `PrepareOperation`, operations.go:211-359) + caller-supplied digest string. Sequence: build `Target{Kind:"operation", Operation=string(req.Kind), Project/Sprint/Study/Stage/Task}` → `repository.Accept(Acceptance{ProductStatus:"prepared", OperationAlias:digest, ConfirmationDigest:digest})` (:103-105). On `ErrConflict` WITH non-empty digest only: resolve alias → return `{RunID, Context: caller ctx unchanged, Existing:true, Lifecycle}` (:106-112) — no claim, no fence, no ownership. Any other Accept error fails closed (:113-115). Then `Claim{Lease: OwnerLeaseDuration=15s}` (:116-119), fence assembled from attempt (:120), first `lifecycle=running` append via `appendRunEventWithRetry`; if THAT fails, proposes `TerminalPersistenceLost` ("operation start persistence failed") on a detached 30 s context using the just-minted fence BEFORE returning the error (:121-129). Success path: `operationCtx = WithCancel(WithParentRun(ctx, RunID))` plus a context value `durableOperationOwnership{repository, fence}` (:130-131); ownership stored in per-instance map `m.owned[RunID]` (:132-135); control goroutine spawned (:136); returns `{RunID, Context: operationCtx, Lifecycle:"running"}`.

### 2.3 QA writer-token handoff (`qaOwnershipFromContext` :140-156)
Extracts `durableOperationOwnership` from ctx; builds `sprint.QAWriterToken{RunID, OperationalAttemptID, FencingGeneration}` (sprint/qa_types.go:179-191) plus a fence closure: full struct equality against the minted token else `ErrStaleFence` (:147-149); on match performs `repository.Heartbeat(context.WithTimeout(context.WithoutCancel(ctx), 30s), fence, 15s lease)` (:150-153) — heartbeating survives outer-context cancellation for bounded post-run writes. Consumers: `durableCLICommand.QAWriterToken()` (:64-69) used by `sprint qa run/resume` (sprint_commands.go:419-442: token+fence → `WithQAWriterFence(fence)` → `RunQA(durable.Context(), ...)`); and `sharedOperationRunner` OperationQAStart/QAResume reads the SAME context value from the accepted operation ctx (operation_runner.go:114-130). Sprint side: `checkWriter` requires a configured fence before every QA publish (sprint/qa_state.go:453-465); without an installed fence sprint falls back to comparing against `req.WriterToken` (sprint/qa.go:260-267).

61: ## 5. Invariants (as implemented)
62: 
63: - Accept-before-execute: no child runtime work begins until Accept+Claim(+first append for operations; Accept+Claim for runtime runs) succeed; acceptance-persistence failure prevents base.StartRun entirely (test-pinned, §10).

75: 
76: - Transport → server: `ExpectedFingerprint` stripped and recomputed server-side; stale fingerprint rejected before runner dispatch (operations.go:215, :376-386). Confirmation tokens consumed once server-side (web preparation store); dedup keys derived server-side from session+token (security.go:448-451). 80: - Child-process boundary: `run_control_run_id` metadata injection clones the caller's metadata map before mutation (run_control.go:186-187); prompt content itself is never persisted here (test-pinned "never persisted").

83: 
84: Effects: runcontrol db rows/WAL via shared pool; child runtime execution (network sessions, provider APIs — owned by platform/runtime surfaces); sprint/study/QA workspace file mutations triggered by product code running INSIDE accepted contexts; stdout/stderr presentation. 86: Acceptance failure ⇒ operation never exists beyond its accepted row (if any); CLI exits ExitRuntime; web handler surfaces error (unless degraded mode). Claim failure after successful Accept leaves an accepted-unclaimed row for reconciliation (grace 45 s — dependency surface). Start-append failure ⇒ persistence_lost terminal, start aborts. Mid-run persistence failure ⇒ runCtx cancel → base runtime observes cancellation → persistence_lost terminal; error joined into returned error (runtime tier) or implicit via context (operation tier). Heartbeat/poll/reconcile failure ⇒ same cancel path (manager variant silent; runtime variant recorded). Retry posture: appends ≤5 s on Unavailable/Busy; terminals effectively until 30 s ctx expiry. 105: App package (baseline green; review/baseline):

107: - durable_operations_test.go: full outer lifecycle accept→claim→ParentRun ctx→running snapshot→QA token/fence roundtrip incl. WithoutCancel cleanup fence and stale-generation rejection→record event (message omitted, tool/phase payload retained)→finish→succeeded LastSequence=3 (:11-90); cross-manager alias dedup Existing:true + closed-repository accept fails non-conflict (:92-124).

118: 1. Ownership scoping asymmetry: alias dedup is repository-wide but `m.owned` is per-manager-instance; a different manager (or process) cannot finish/record for a run it did not accept (nil-op success / ErrNotFound). Cross-instance finishing relies solely on lease expiry + reconciliation.

132: 15. `RecordOperationCleanupUncertain`/`ReconcileOperations` (web shutdown drain) write product-owned cleanup markers, not runcontrol rows — relationship to outer run terminals is defined only by convention.

54: ## 4. Authoritative state
55: 
56: - Durable authority is `.ultraplan/run-control.db` (schema/ownership: surface `run-journal-fencing`). 61: ## 5. Invariants (as implemented)
62: 
63: - Accept-before-execute: no child runtime work begins until Accept+Claim(+first append for operations; Accept+Claim for runtime runs) succeed; acceptance-persistence failure prevents base.StartRun entirely (test-pinned, §10).
64: - Persistence-gated delivery: display/downstream callbacks fire only after the corresponding Append commits, in both spine variants (run_control.go:246-248; web publishAppEvent; TUI emit gating).
65: - One claim per run lifetime, one terminal winner, monotonic sequences: inherited from runcontrol CAS/fencing (dependency surface); this surface always operates through freshly minted per-attempt fences and never mutates rows directly.
66: - Fail-closed on persistence loss: mid-run append/heartbeat/poll/reconcile failure cancels the run context (work drains through cancellation) and ends in a `persistence_lost` terminal proposed on a detached context; start-time append failure terminalizes before returning.
67: - Coalescing never loses counts: collapsed duplicates accumulate into Omission {reason, count, first/last} carried by the next committed event or flushed at finish; committed=false also suppresses duplicate local display.
68: - Cancellation path: external request persisted (ownerless) → observed within ≤1 s tick → fenced AcknowledgeCancellation → local context cancel → product drains → terminal arbitration decides cancelled-vs-completed with single-winner guarantee.
69: - Detached-terminal discipline: every finish/terminal/QA-heartbeat write uses a fresh ≤30 s background context (`context.Background()`/`WithoutCancel`), so shutdown or run-context cancellation cannot prevent terminal commit; append retries are strictly 5 s-bounded.
70: - Single process owner: all claims of one process share Owner.ID; fencing generations distinguish attempts.
71: - Boundedness at the boundary: target fields ≤512 B, payload values ≤32 KiB, payload ≤30 entries, keys ≤128 B, control bytes stripped before storage validation sees them.

74: ## 6. Trust boundaries
75: 
76: - Transport → server: `ExpectedFingerprint` stripped and recomputed server-side; stale fingerprint rejected before runner dispatch (operations.go:215, :376-386). 82: ## 7. External effects & cancellation/retry/restart/error semantics

84: Effects: runcontrol db rows/WAL via shared pool; child runtime execution (network sessions, provider APIs — owned by platform/runtime surfaces); sprint/study/QA workspace file mutations triggered by product code running INSIDE accepted contexts; stdout/stderr presentation. 85: 
86: Acceptance failure ⇒ operation never exists beyond its accepted row (if any); CLI exits ExitRuntime; web handler surfaces error (unless degraded mode). Claim failure after successful Accept leaves an accepted-unclaimed row for reconciliation (grace 45 s — dependency surface). Start-append failure ⇒ persistence_lost terminal, start aborts. Mid-run persistence failure ⇒ runCtx cancel → base runtime observes cancellation → persistence_lost terminal; error joined into returned error (runtime tier) or implicit via context (operation tier). Heartbeat/poll/reconcile failure ⇒ same cancel path (manager variant silent; runtime variant recorded). Retry posture: appends ≤5 s on Unavailable/Busy; terminals effectively until 30 s ctx expiry. Restart/crash: abandoned outer runs keep leases expiring at 15 s; reconciliation (startup + periodic, dependency surface) terminalizes them interrupted/uncertain using birth identity; restarted work is a NEW run correlated by ParentRun/ProductRunID, never adopted. 116: ## 11. Explicit unknowns / open questions (for later reviewers)
117: 
118: 1. Ownership scoping asymmetry: alias dedup is repository-wide but `m.owned` is per-manager-instance; a different manager (or process) cannot finish/record for a run it did not accept (nil-op success / ErrNotFound). Cross-instance finishing relies solely on lease expiry + reconciliation.

42: 	defer s.mu.Unlock()
43: 	if s.initErr != nil {
44: 		return nil, s.initErr
45: 	}
46: 	if repository := s.repos[workspaceRoot]; repository != nil {
47: 		if len(policies) > 0 && s.policies[workspaceRoot] != policies[0] {
48: 			return nil, errors.New("run-control retention policy changed during the process lifetime")
49: 		}
50: 		return repository, nil
51: 	}
52: 	var retention runcontrol.RetentionPolicy
53: 	if len(policies) > 0 {
54: 		retention = policies[0]
55: 	}
56: 	repository, err := runcontrol.OpenSQLite(ctx, workspaceRoot, runcontrol.SQLiteOptions{Retention: retention})
57: 	if err != nil {
58: 		return nil, err
59: 	}
60: 	logger, err := runcontrol.OpenLocalFileLogger(workspaceRoot)
61: 	if err != nil {
62: 		_ = repository.Close()
63: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("open run-control diagnostic log: %w", err)
64: 	}
65: 	repository.SetLogger(logger)
66: 	if _, err := repository.Reconcile(ctx, runcontrol.NativeProcessProbe{}, runcontrol.ReconcileOptions{}); err != nil {
67: 		_ = repository.Close()
68: 		_ = logger.Close()
69: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("startup run reconciliation failed: %w", err)
70: 	}
71: 	s.repos[workspaceRoot] = repository
72: 	s.loggers[workspaceRoot] = logger
73: 	s.policies[workspaceRoot] = retention
74: 	return repository, nil
75: }

78: 	if s == nil {
79: 		return
80: 	}
81: 	s.mu.Lock()
82: 	defer s.mu.Unlock()
83: 	for root, repository := range s.repos {

85: 		if logger := s.loggers[root]; logger != nil {
86: 			_ = logger.Close()
87: 			delete(s.loggers, root)
88: 		}
89: 		delete(s.repos, root)
90: 	}

159: func (r controlledRuntime) StartRun(ctx context.Context, req runtimepkg.Request) (runtimepkg.Result, error) {
160: 	target := targetFromRuntimeRequest(req)
161: 	correlation := runcontrol.Correlation{
162: 		ProductRunID:  boundedSafe(string(runcontrol.ParentRun(ctx))),
163: 		ProductTaskID: boundedSafe(req.TraceID),
164: 	}
165: 	snapshot, err := r.repository.Accept(ctx, runcontrol.Acceptance{
166: 		Target:        target,
167: 		Correlation:   correlation,
168: 		ProductStatus: "accepted",
169: 	})
170: 	if err != nil {
171: 		return runtimepkg.Result{}, fmt.Errorf("durable run acceptance failed: %w", err)
172: 	}
173: 	attempt, _, err := r.repository.Claim(ctx, runcontrol.Claim{
174: 		RunID: snapshot.RunID, Owner: r.owner, Lease: runControlLease, Correlation: correlation,
175: 	})
176: 	if err != nil {
177: 		return runtimepkg.Result{}, fmt.Errorf("durable run ownership failed: %w", err)
178: 	}
179: 	fence := runcontrol.Fence{
180: 		RunID: snapshot.RunID, AttemptID: attempt.ID, OwnerID: r.owner.ID,
181: 		FencingGeneration: attempt.FencingGeneration,
182: 	}
183: 
184: 	runCtx, cancel := context.WithCancel(ctx)
185: 	defer cancel()
186: 	req.Metadata = cloneRuntimeMetadata(req.Metadata)
187: 	req.Metadata["run_control_run_id"] = string(snapshot.RunID)
188: 	configuredOnEvent := req.OnEvent
189: 	var eventMu sync.Mutex
190: 	var persistenceErr error
191: 	var progressKey string
192: 	var progressCommittedAt time.Time
193: 	var progressOmitted uint64
194: 	var progressOmittedFirst time.Time
195: 	var progressOmittedLast time.Time
196: 	setPersistenceErr := func(value error) {
197: 		eventMu.Lock()
198: 		defer eventMu.Unlock()
199: 		if persistenceErr == nil {
200: 			persistenceErr = value
201: 			cancel()
202: 		}
203: 	}
204: 	req.OnEvent = func(event runtimepkg.Event) {
205: 		eventMu.Lock()
206: 		defer eventMu.Unlock()
207: 		if persistenceErr != nil {
208: 			return
209: 		}
210: 		draft := runtimeEventDraft(req, event)
211: 		eventAt := event.Time.UTC()
212: 		if eventAt.IsZero() {
213: 			eventAt = time.Now().UTC()
214: 		}
215: 		// Content-aware coalescing: only collapse identical progress payloads within the window.
216: 		// Reasoning/text deltas and tool calls have distinct payload hashes and will not coalesce.
217: 		hash := payloadHash(draft.Payload)
218: 		key := string(draft.Type) + "\x00" + draft.Stage + "\x00" + draft.Task + "\x00" + hash
219: 		elapsed := eventAt.Sub(progressCommittedAt)
220: 		if draft.Type == runcontrol.EventProgress && key == progressKey && elapsed >= 0 && elapsed < runcontrol.ProgressCoalesceWindow {
221: 			if progressOmitted == 0 {
222: 				progressOmittedFirst = eventAt
223: 			}
224: 			progressOmitted++
225: 			progressOmittedLast = eventAt
226: 			return
227: 		}
228: 		if progressOmitted > 0 {
229: 			if draft.Omission == nil {
230: 				draft.Omission = &runcontrol.Omission{Reason: "equivalent progress coalesced"}
231: 			}
232: 			draft.Omission.Count += progressOmitted
233: 			draft.Omission.FirstAt = &progressOmittedFirst
234: 			draft.Omission.LastAt = &progressOmittedLast
235: 			progressOmitted = 0
236: 		}
237: 		if _, _, appendErr := appendRunEventWithRetry(runCtx, r.repository, fence, draft); appendErr != nil {
238: 			persistenceErr = fmt.Errorf("persist runtime event: %w", appendErr)
239: 			cancel()
240: 			return
241: 		}
242: 		if draft.Type == runcontrol.EventProgress {
243: 			progressKey = key
244: 			progressCommittedAt = eventAt
245: 		}
246: 		if configuredOnEvent != nil {
247: 			configuredOnEvent(event)
248: 		}
249: 	}
250: 
251: 	controlDone := make(chan struct{})
252: 	go func() {
253: 		defer close(controlDone)
254: 		ticker := time.NewTicker(runcontrol.OwnerTickInterval)
255: 		defer ticker.Stop()
256: 		lastHeartbeat := time.Now()
257: 		lastReconcile := time.Now()
258: 		for {
259: 			select {
260: 			case <-runCtx.Done():
261: 				return
262: 			case now := <-ticker.C:
263: 				snapshot, err := r.repository.Snapshot(runCtx, fence.RunID)
264: 				if err != nil {
265: 					if runCtx.Err() != nil {
266: 						return
267: 					}
268: 					setPersistenceErr(fmt.Errorf("poll durable run control: %w", err))
269: 					return
270: 				}
271: 				if snapshot.Cancellation.State == runcontrol.CancellationRequested {
272: 					if _, _, err := r.repository.AcknowledgeCancellation(runCtx, fence); err != nil {
273: 						setPersistenceErr(fmt.Errorf("acknowledge durable cancellation: %w", err))
274: 						return
275: 					}
276: 					cancel()
277: 					return
278: 				}
279: 				if now.Sub(lastHeartbeat) >= runcontrol.HeartbeatInterval {
280: 					if _, err := r.repository.Heartbeat(runCtx, fence, runControlLease); err != nil {
281: 						if runCtx.Err() != nil {
282: 							return
283: 						}
284: 						setPersistenceErr(fmt.Errorf("persist owner heartbeat: %w", err))
285: 						return
286: 					}
287: 					lastHeartbeat = now
288: 				}
289: 				if now.Sub(lastReconcile) >= runcontrol.ReconciliationInterval {
290: 					if _, err := r.repository.Reconcile(runCtx, runcontrol.NativeProcessProbe{}, runcontrol.ReconcileOptions{}); err != nil {
291: 						if runCtx.Err() != nil {
292: 							return
293: 						}
294: 						setPersistenceErr(fmt.Errorf("reconcile durable runs: %w", err))
295: 						return
296: 					}
297: 					lastReconcile = now
298: 				}
299: 			}
300: 		}
301: 	}()
302: 	result, runErr := r.base.StartRun(runCtx, req)
303: 	eventMu.Lock()
304: 	if persistenceErr == nil && progressOmitted > 0 {
305: 		_, _, appendErr := appendRunEventWithRetry(runCtx, r.repository, fence, runcontrol.EventDraft{
306: 			Type: runcontrol.EventOmission,
307: 			Omission: &runcontrol.Omission{
308: 				Reason: "equivalent progress coalesced", Count: progressOmitted,
309: 				FirstAt: &progressOmittedFirst, LastAt: &progressOmittedLast,
310: 			},
311: 		})
312: 		if appendErr != nil {
313: 			persistenceErr = fmt.Errorf("persist progress omission: %w", appendErr)
314: 		}
315: 	}
316: 	eventMu.Unlock()
317: 	cancel()
318: 	<-controlDone
319: 	eventMu.Lock()
320: 	persistErr := persistenceErr
321: 	eventMu.Unlock()
322: 	if persistErr != nil {
323: 		terminalCtx, terminalCancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 30*time.Second)
324: 		_, _, terminalErr := proposeRunTerminalWithRetry(terminalCtx, r.repository, fence, runcontrol.TerminalProposal{
325: 			Outcome: runcontrol.TerminalPersistenceLost, Reason: "durable event persistence failed", ProposedBy: r.owner.ID,
326: 		})
327: 		terminalCancel()
328: 		if terminalErr != nil {
329: 			return result, errors.Join(persistErr, terminalErr)
330: 		}
331: 		return result, persistErr
332: 	}
333: 
334: 	outcome, reason := terminalOutcome(result, runErr, ctx)
335: 	terminalCtx, terminalCancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 30*time.Second)
336: 	defer terminalCancel()
337: 	if _, _, err := proposeRunTerminalWithRetry(terminalCtx, r.repository, fence, runcontrol.TerminalProposal{
338: 		Outcome: outcome, Reason: reason, ProposedBy: r.owner.ID,
339: 	}); err != nil {
340: 		return result, errors.Join(runErr, fmt.Errorf("persist terminal run outcome: %w", err))
341: 	}
342: 	return result, runErr
343: }

345: func appendRunEventWithRetry(ctx context.Context, repository runcontrol.Repository, fence runcontrol.Fence, draft runcontrol.EventDraft) (runcontrol.Event, runcontrol.Snapshot, error) {
346: 	deadline := time.Now().Add(5 * time.Second)
347: 	for {
348: 		event, snapshot, err := repository.Append(ctx, fence, draft)
349: 		if err == nil || !retryableRunControlError(err) || !time.Now().Before(deadline) {
350: 			return event, snapshot, err
351: 		}
352: 		if err := waitRunControlRetry(ctx, deadline); err != nil {
353: 			return runcontrol.Event{}, runcontrol.Snapshot{}, err
354: 		}
355: 	}
356: }
357: 
358: func proposeRunTerminalWithRetry(ctx context.Context, repository runcontrol.Repository, fence runcontrol.Fence, proposal runcontrol.TerminalProposal) (runcontrol.Snapshot, bool, error) {
359: 	for {
360: 		snapshot, won, err := repository.ProposeTerminal(ctx, fence, proposal)
361: 		if err == nil || !retryableRunControlError(err) {
362: 			return snapshot, won, err
363: 		}
364: 		if err := waitRunControlRetry(ctx, time.Now().Add(250*time.Millisecond)); err != nil {
365: 			return runcontrol.Snapshot{}, false, err
366: 		}
367: 	}
368: }

370: func retryableRunControlError(err error) bool {
371: 	return errors.Is(err, runcontrol.ErrUnavailable) || errors.Is(err, runcontrol.ErrBusy)
372: }
373: 
374: func waitRunControlRetry(ctx context.Context, deadline time.Time) error {
375: 	wait := time.Until(deadline)
376: 	if wait > 100*time.Millisecond {
377: 		wait = 100 * time.Millisecond
378: 	}
379: 	if wait <= 0 {
380: 		return context.DeadlineExceeded
381: 	}
382: 	timer := time.NewTimer(wait)
383: 	defer timer.Stop()
384: 	select {
385: 	case <-ctx.Done():
386: 		return ctx.Err()
387: 	case <-timer.C:
388: 		return nil
389: 	}
390: }

392: func targetFromRuntimeRequest(req runtimepkg.Request) runcontrol.Target {

396: 		Project:   boundedSafe(req.Metadata["project"]),
397: 		Sprint:    boundedSafe(req.Metadata["sprint"]),

399: 		Stage:     boundedSafe(req.Metadata["stage"]),
400: 		Task:      boundedSafe(firstSafeValue(req.Metadata["task"], req.Metadata["task.kind"], req.Metadata["coverage"])),

409: 		}

411: 	if target.Operation == "" {
412: 		target.Operation = boundedSafe(firstSafeValue(target.Stage, req.Metadata["task.kind"], req.PromptRef.ID, "runtime"))
413: 	}
414: 	return target
415: }

417: func runtimeEventDraft(req runtimepkg.Request, event runtimepkg.Event) runcontrol.EventDraft {
418: 	eventType := runcontrol.EventProgress
419: 	lowerType := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(event.Type))
420: 	lowerKind := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(event.Kind))
421: 	switch lowerType {
422: 	case "warning", "warn", "error":
423: 		eventType = runcontrol.EventWarning
424: 	case "artifact", "file":
425: 		eventType = runcontrol.EventArtifact
426: 	case "finding":
427: 		eventType = runcontrol.EventFinding
428: 	case "message", "text", "output", "assistant_text", "reasoning_text", "reasoning", "content", "delta":
429: 		eventType = runcontrol.EventMessage
430: 	default:
431: 		// Kind-based fallback: reasoning and message kinds should be visible as message, not coalesced progress.
432: 		switch lowerKind {
433: 		case "message", "reasoning", "assistant", "assistant_text", "reasoning_text":
434: 			eventType = runcontrol.EventMessage
435: 		case "tool", "tool_use", "tool_call", "tool_call_update":
436: 			// Tools stay as progress but with distinct payload so coalescing can distinguish.
437: 			eventType = runcontrol.EventProgress
438: 		}
439: 	}
440: 	payload := map[string]string{
441: 		"runtime_event_id": boundedSafe(event.ID),
442: 		"runtime_run_id":   boundedSafe(event.RunID),
443: 		"session_id":       boundedSafe(event.SessionID),
444: 		"type":             boundedSafe(event.Type),
445: 		"kind":             boundedSafe(event.Kind),
446: 	}
447: 	if lowerKind == "tool" || lowerKind == "tool_use" || lowerKind == "tool_call" || lowerKind == "tool_call_update" {
448: 		captureToolObservation(payload, event.Payload)
449: 	}
450: 	// Preserve safe observable payload fields into durable storage for observability.
451: 	// Deny sensitive keys and truncate values to runcontrol-safe limits.
452: 	// Flatten one level of nesting so tool/action names buried in maps are surfaced as top-level payload keys
453: 	// that the run timeline JS expects (payload.tool, payload.action, payload.title, etc.).
454: 	for key, value := range event.Payload {
455: 		if isSensitivePayloadKey(key) {
456: 			continue
457: 		}
458: 		normalized := strings.TrimSpace(key)
459: 		if normalized == "" || len(normalized) > 128 || strings.ContainsAny(normalized, "\x00\r\n") {
460: 			continue
461: 		}
462: 		if normalized == "type" || normalized == "kind" {
463: 			continue
464: 		}
465: 		if nested, ok := value.(map[string]any); ok {
466: 			for subKey, subVal := range nested {
467: 				if isSensitivePayloadKey(subKey) {
468: 					continue
469: 				}
470: 				subNorm := strings.TrimSpace(subKey)
471: 				if subNorm == "" || len(subNorm) > 128 || strings.ContainsAny(subNorm, "\x00\r\n") {
472: 					continue
473: 				}
474: 				if _, exists := payload[subNorm]; exists {
475: 					continue
476: 				}
477: 				// Promote common observable sub-keys; namespace the rest to avoid collisions.
478: 				promote := map[string]bool{"tool": true, "title": true, "detail": true, "text": true, "delta": true, "content": true, "message": true, "action": true, "state": true, "status": true, "native_type": true, "line": true}
479: 				targetKey := subNorm
480: 				if !promote[subNorm] {
481: 					targetKey = normalized + "_" + subNorm
482: 					if len(targetKey) > 128 {
483: 						continue
484: 					}
485: 				}
486: 				if _, exists := payload[targetKey]; exists {
487: 					continue
488: 				}
489: 				str := payloadValueString(subVal)
490: 				if strings.TrimSpace(str) == "" {
491: 					continue
492: 				}
493: 				if len(payload) >= 30 {
494: 					break
495: 				}
496: 				payload[targetKey] = boundedPayloadValue(str)
497: 			}
498: 			// Also keep a compact stringified top-level for debugging if not promoted.
499: 			if len(payload) < 30 {
500: 				if _, exists := payload[normalized]; !exists {
501: 					str := payloadValueString(value)
502: 					if strings.TrimSpace(str) != "" && !strings.HasPrefix(str, "[map omitted") {
503: 						payload[normalized] = boundedPayloadValue(str)
504: 					}
505: 				}
506: 			}
507: 			continue
508: 		}
509: 		str := payloadValueString(value)
510: 		if strings.TrimSpace(str) == "" {
511: 			continue
512: 		}
513: 		if len(payload) >= 30 {
514: 			break
515: 		}
516: 		if _, exists := payload[normalized]; exists {
517: 			continue
518: 		}
519: 		payload[normalized] = boundedPayloadValue(str)
520: 	}
521: 	// Ensure the most useful display keys are always present even if nested.
522: 	for _, want := range []string{"tool", "action", "title", "detail", "text", "delta"} {
523: 		if _, ok := payload[want]; ok {
524: 			continue
525: 		}
526: 		if v := findNestedString(event.Payload, want); v != "" {
527: 			payload[want] = boundedPayloadValue(v)
528: 		}
529: 	}
530: 	omission := (*runcontrol.Omission)(nil)
531: 	if event.RawPresent || event.RawOmitted {
532: 		reason := firstSafeValue(event.RawOmissionReason, "runtime payload omitted by safe persistence policy")
533: 		omission = &runcontrol.Omission{Reason: boundedSafe(reason), Count: 1}
534: 	} else if len(event.Payload) > len(payload)-5 {
535: 		// Payload had more fields than we persisted (truncated/omitted keys) – record for diagnostics but don't hide persisted fields.
536: 		omission = &runcontrol.Omission{Reason: boundedSafe("runtime payload truncated to safe observable fields"), Count: 1}
537: 	}
538: 	return runcontrol.EventDraft{
539: 		Type: eventType, Scope: runcontrol.EventScopeRuntime,
540: 		Stage: boundedSafe(req.Metadata["stage"]), Task: boundedSafe(firstSafeValue(req.Metadata["task"], req.Metadata["task.kind"])),
541: 		Kind: payload["kind"], Tool: payload["tool"], Action: payload["action"],
542: 		Reason: payload["reason"], Detail: firstSafeValue(payload["detail"], payload["title"]),
543: 		Payload: payload, Omission: omission,
544: 	}
545: }

547: func isSensitivePayloadKey(key string) bool {
548: 	lower := strings.ToLower(key)
549: 	for _, marker := range []string{"secret", "token", "password", "authorization", "cookie", "api_key", "apikey", "credential", "auth"} {
550: 		if strings.Contains(lower, marker) {
551: 			return true
552: 		}
553: 	}
554: 	return false
555: }
556: 
557: func findNestedString(payload map[string]any, want string) string {
558: 	for _, v := range payload {
559: 		if m, ok := v.(map[string]any); ok {
560: 			if s, ok := m[want].(string); ok && strings.TrimSpace(s) != "" {
561: 				return s
562: 			}
563: 			// One more level deep (common for opencode part.state structures)
564: 			for _, inner := range m {
565: 				if innerMap, ok := inner.(map[string]any); ok {
566: 					if s, ok := innerMap[want].(string); ok && strings.TrimSpace(s) != "" {
567: 						return s
568: 					}
569: 				}
570: 			}
571: 		}
572: 	}
573: 	return ""
574: }
575: 
576: func payloadValueString(value any) string {
577: 	switch v := value.(type) {
578: 	case string:
579: 		return v
580: 	case []byte:
581: 		if len(v) == 0 {
582: 			return ""
583: 		}
584: 		return string(v)
585: 	case bool:
586: 		if v {
587: 			return "true"
588: 		}
589: 		return "false"
590: 	case int:
591: 		return fmt.Sprintf("%d", v)
592: 	case int8:
593: 		return fmt.Sprintf("%d", v)
594: 	case int16:
595: 		return fmt.Sprintf("%d", v)
596: 	case int32:
597: 		return fmt.Sprintf("%d", v)

482: 	var records []*operationRecord
483: 	for _, record := range h.records {
484: 		if !terminalOperationState(record.doc.State) {
485: 			records = append(records, record)

487: 	}
488: 	h.mu.Unlock()

494: 		select {

496: 		case <-ctx.Done():

505: func (h *operationHub) persistCleanupUncertain(records []*operationRecord) error {

508: 		return errors.New("operation capability cannot persist cleanup uncertainty")
509: 	}

511: 	for _, record := range records {
512: 		h.mu.Lock()
513: 		terminal := terminalOperationState(record.doc.State)
514: 		h.mu.Unlock()

516: 			continue
517: 		}

521: 			Request:     record.request,
522: 			Reason:      "server_shutdown",
523: 			RecordedAt:  h.now().UTC(),

533: func (h *operationHub) markCleanupUncertain(records []*operationRecord) {
534: 	h.mu.Lock()
535: 	defer h.mu.Unlock()
536: 	finished := h.now().UTC()
537: 	for _, record := range records {
538: 		if terminalOperationState(record.doc.State) {
539: 			continue
540: 		}
541: 		record.doc.State = "cleanup_uncertain"
542: 		record.doc.Reason = "server_shutdown"
543: 		record.doc.FinishedAt = &finished
544: 		record.doc.Result = &operationResultDTO{State: "cleanup_uncertain", Message: "Cleanup did not finish before the shutdown deadline. Refresh durable status before retrying."}

546: 		h.active--
547: 		h.counters.active.Add(-1)
548: 		h.counters.terminal.Add(1)
549: 		close(record.done)
550: 		for id, subscriber := range record.subscribers {
551: 			close(subscriber.ch)
552: 			delete(record.subscribers, id)
553: 			h.streams--
554: 			h.counters.activeStreams.Add(-1)
555: 		}
556: 	}

565: func (h *operationHub) reapLocked() {
566: 	now := h.now().UTC()
567: 	for id, record := range h.records {

570: 			if record.dedupKey != "" {
571: 				delete(h.dedup, record.dedupKey)
572: 			}
573: 		}
574: 	}

577: func projectOperationResult(result app.OperationResult) *operationResultDTO {
578: 	out := &operationResultDTO{
579: 		State: safeWebText(string(result.State)), Subject: safeWebText(result.Subject), Message: safeWebText(result.Message),
580: 		Content: safeProjectedText(result.Content, MaxTerminalResultBytes/2), Truncated: result.Truncated,
581: 	}
582: 	for _, finding := range result.Findings {
583: 		out.Findings = append(out.Findings, findingDTO{
584: 			Severity: safeWebText(finding.Severity), Section: safeWebText(finding.Section), Problem: safeWebText(finding.Problem),
585: 			Cause: safeWebText(finding.Cause), Suggestion: safeWebText(finding.Suggestion),
586: 		})
587: 	}
588: 	if result.Error != nil {
589: 		out.Error = &errorBody{Code: safeWebText(result.Error.Code), Message: safeWebText(result.Error.Message), Retryable: result.Error.Retryable, Details: map[string]any{
590: 			"category": safeWebText(result.Error.Category), "component": safeWebText(result.Error.Component), "cause": safeWebText(result.Error.Cause), "guidance": safeWebText(result.Error.Guidance),
591: 		}}
592: 	}

594: 		out.Content = ""
595: 		out.Findings = nil
596: 		out.Truncated = true
597: 		out.Message = safeBoundedText(out.Message, 4096)

599: 	return out

602: func cloneOperationDocument(doc operationDocument) operationDocument {
603: 	clone := doc

605: 		result := *doc.Result
606: 		result.Findings = append([]findingDTO(nil), doc.Result.Findings...)
607: 		if doc.Result.Error != nil {
608: 			err := *doc.Result.Error
609: 			result.Error = &err
610: 		}
611: 		clone.Result = &result
612: 	}

616: func terminalOperationState(state string) bool {
617: 	switch state {
618: 	case "succeeded", "failed", "cancelled", "interrupted", "cleanup_uncertain":
619: 		return true
620: 	default:
621: 		return false
622: 	}

628: 		return reason

638: func safeProjectedText(value string, limit int) string {
639: 	value = strings.TrimSpace(value)
640: 	lower := strings.ToLower(value)
641: 	for _, marker := range []string{"token=", "secret=", "authorization:", "cookie:"} {
642: 		if index := strings.Index(lower, marker); index >= 0 {
643: 			value = value[:index] + "[redacted]"
644: 			lower = strings.ToLower(value)
645: 		}
646: 	}
647: 	if strings.Contains(value, "/home/") || strings.Contains(value, `C:\\Users\\`) {
648: 		value = "[redacted path]"
649: 	}
650: 	return safeBoundedText(value, limit)

654: 	if len(value) <= limit {

Both defects are now empirically confirmed in the isolated sandbox (`/tmp/opencode/upgo-verify`, target untouched):

- **Cancel + pending coalesced duplicate → recorded as `persistence_degraded`** (contrast case without duplicate → correct `cancelled`)
- **Single manager tick failure → recorded as plain `cancelled`, zero diagnostic events** (`events=[lifecycle terminal]`)

---

# Findings — `durable-operation-spine` (verification/operability lens)

## Finding 1 — HIGH: Runtime-tier trailing omission flush runs on an already-canceled context, misclassifying ordinary cancellations/timeouts as `persistence_degraded`

**Claim.** In `controlledRuntime.StartRun`, the trailing coalesced-progress flush (internal/app/run_control.go:304-315) appends via `appendRunEventWithRetry(runCtx, …)` after `base.StartRun` returns. On any parent cancellation or deadline expiry, `runCtx` is already canceled, so `repository.Append` fails at `BeginTx` and returns `ctx.Err()` verbatim (internal/runcontrol/sqlite.go:639-644). That error poisons `persistenceErr`, which bypasses `terminalOutcome` entirely and proposes `TerminalPersistenceLost` ("durable event persistence failed") for what is actually a clean user cancellation or timeout (run_control.go:322-331), and replaces the returned error with `persist progress omission: context canceled`.

**Observable bad outcome (reproduced).** Ctrl-C / SIGTERM (`signal.NotifyContext`, cmd/ultraplan/main.go:19) or request-deadline expiry during any sprint/study inner run that has one pending coalesced duplicate (two identical progress ticks inside the 250 ms window — the normal steady-state during long stages) yields:
- durable terminal outcome `persistence_degraded`, reason `"durable event persistence failed"` — false storage-outage alarm in the journal, `/runs/<id>` timeline, and health projections;
- user/adapter-facing error `"persist progress omission: context canceled"` blaming persistence for a plain cancellation;
- timeouts recorded as degraded instead of `timed_out`.

Repro: `TestVerifyCancelWithPendingCoalescedProgress` fails with `outcome="persistence_degraded" reason="durable event persistence failed"`; the contrast case without a pending duplicate passes with `cancelled` — isolating the precondition precisely.

**Trigger/preconditions.** Parent ctx canceled or deadline exceeded while `progressOmitted > 0` at base-runtime return. No storage fault required.

**Evidence path.** runCtx := WithCancel(ctx) (:184) → parent cancel cancels runCtx → base returns `context.Canceled` → flush attempt on runCtx (:305) → Append BeginTx fails returning `ctx.Err()` (sqlite.go:641-643) → `persistenceErr` set (:313) → skips `terminalOutcome` (:334) → ProposeTerminal(`TerminalPersistenceLost`) succeeds because fence/run are still active (:322-327).

**Existing controls / counter-evidence searched.** `appendRunEventWithRetry` retries only `ErrUnavailable|ErrBusy`; `context.Canceled` isn't retryable, and the 5 s wall deadline can't help a dead context. The manager tier does NOT have this bug: `durableCLICommand.Finish` (durable_operations.go:78), TUI (tui/app.go:303), and web (web/operations.go:235) all finish on a fresh detached 30 s context — the asymmetry shows detached-flush is the intended discipline and the runtime-tier flush missed it. No test in frozen HEAD covers flush-failure outcome mapping (pack §10 concedes this; grep confirms). TRD L2202/L2223/L2367 require truthful fail-closed/degraded semantics and detectable partial success; this manufactures a degraded verdict where none occurred.

**Severity / confidence.** High / high (minimal repro executed against frozen source `5d54525b`).

**Regression test.** My `TestVerifyCancelWithPendingCoalescedProgress` (sandbox `/tmp/opencode/upgo-verify/internal/app/zz_verify_spine_test.go`) plus a `WithTimeout` variant: emit two identical progress events, cancel parent, assert `TerminalOutcome == TerminalCancelled` (and `timed_out` for deadline), and that the returned error neither claims persistence failure nor drops cancellation identity. Fix shape: perform the trailing flush on a detached ≤30 s context (matching `FinishOperation` discipline) before reading `persistenceErr`.

## Finding 2 — MEDIUM: Manager-tier control-tick failures cancel silently and are durably recorded as user cancellations, with zero diagnostics

**Claim.** `controlOperation` (internal/app/durable_operations.go:223-264) treats any Snapshot/AcknowledgeCancellation/Heartbeat/Reconcile error as `owned.cancel(); return` — no persisted warning/omission event, no log, no surfaced error. The subsequent `FinishOperation` maps the resulting `context.Canceled` to `TerminalCancelled`/"operation cancelled" (:291-292) before any failed-state branch. Unlike the runtime tier, which records `setPersistenceErr` and distinguishes shutdown from real failure via `runCtx.Err()` guards (run_control.go:265, :281, :291) and ends in `persistence_degraded`, the outer tier makes a transient SQLite outage indistinguishable from a user pressing cancel.

**Observable bad outcome (reproduced).** Injected single-shot Snapshot failure: operation context dies within one 1 s tick; journal reads `[lifecycle, terminal]` with outcome `cancelled`, reason `"operation cancelled"` — no warning, no omission, nothing. Operators post-morteming "who cancelled this run?" get the wrong answer; lease-liveness/persistence incidents are invisible in the durable record. Presentation amplifies it: the TUI emit callback swallows `RecordOperationEvent` errors outright (tui/app.go:289-291), so the stream just freezes.

**Trigger/preconditions.** Any single repository error on one owner tick while an outer operation is active (busy-timeout exhaustion under concurrent writers is a realistic source given per-run heartbeats/reconciles).

**Evidence path.** ticker case → `Snapshot` err (:235-239) → `owned.cancel()` → product drains with Canceled → adapter finish → `FinishOperation` maps `errors.Is(runErr, context.Canceled)` first (:291) → `ProposeTerminal(cancelled)` wins; no diagnostic write exists anywhere in the path.

**Existing controls / counter-evidence searched.** LocalFileLogger logs only repository-level events, none generated here since the goroutine exits without calling anything. Cross-manager finishes rely on reconcile, but here the run is actively terminalized by its own owner, so reconciliation never re-classifies it. Existing tests never drive tick paths (pack §10). The in-repo untracked `zz_gauntlet_repro_test.go` (NOT part of frozen HEAD — leftover artifact; its REPRO 1 also hangs because its spy is never canceled) sketches this scenario but pins rather than fails the buggy behavior; I re-derived and confirmed it independently.

**Severity / confidence.** Medium / high (mechanism fully traced; empirical shape confirmed; severity bounded because execution still fails closed safely — the damage is to record truth and diagnosability).

**Regression test.** Fault-injected `Repository.Snapshot` wrapper (as in my `TestVerifyManagerTickFailureIsSilentlyRecordedAsUserCancellation`): assert either a persisted warning/diagnostic event exists before the terminal, or the outcome is `persistence_degraded`; and that a genuine cancellation (no injected fault) still yields `cancelled`. Fix shape: mirror the runtime tier — record the error (warning event + persistence-lost terminal) and add the `ctx.Err()` shutdown guard parity.

## Minor observations (below reporting threshold alone)

- **Hub projection diverges on timeouts:** web `finish()` has no `timed_out` branch — DeadlineExceeded renders as `failed` in SSE/hub state while the durable journal says `timed_out` (web/operations.go:286-294 vs durable_operations.go:289-290). Display-only divergence.
- **`payloadHash` is concatenation, not a hash,** and is ambiguous for keys containing `=` ({"a":"b=c"} ≡ {"a=b":"c"}, run_control.go:730-752); worst case is one distinct progress tick suppressed into the omission count within a 250 ms window. Values are NUL-stripped, so blast radius is tiny.

## Defended non-issues (checked, with disproof)

- **Empty CLI digest breaking repeat accepts:** `Accept` inserts alias rows only when non-empty (sqlite.go:445) and `confirmation_digest` carries no UNIQUE constraint (schema sqlite.go:259) — sequential CLI operations accept cleanly.
- **Retention policy mismatch killing mixed CLI commands:** `runRepository` passes the identical `runControlRetentionPolicy(effective.Config)` as `controlledRuntimeFor` (run_commands.go:54 vs run_control.go:146) — no mismatch path.
- **Silent retention misconfig:** durations/quota validated at config load (config/config.go:487-500); `runControlRetentionPolicy`'s ignored parse errors see only validated strings.
- **Smoke escaping the spine:** `RunSmoke` never touches the runtime interface (no StartRun references in internal/sprint/smoke.go); plain `NewService` in both adapters is consistent.
- **Fingerprint trust boundary:** transport `ExpectedFingerprint` cleared then recomputed server-side (operations.go:215, :367-372), re-verified before dispatch (:401-408); web dedup keys derived server-side from session+token (security.go:448). Holds.
- **QA fence post-terminal:** `ProposeTerminal` sets `attempts.outcome` (sqlite.go:787-788), so post-finish heartbeats correctly fail `StaleFence` — fencing intact.
- **Per-operation reconcile cadence cost:** batched `LIMIT`-bounded scans (lifecycle.go:321-367); healthy-path cost is two indexed queries per active run per 10 s — not a hazard at web caps (8 ops) or study parallelism (≤64).
- **Cross-mutex ordering (inner eventMu → outer eventMu via TUI observer chain):** one-directional; no reverse acquisition exists — no deadlock.

Artifact hygiene note: the target working tree contains an untracked leftover `internal/app/zz_gauntlet_repro_test.go` from a prior attempt — not part of frozen `5d54525b`; its REPRO 1 hangs (spy never canceled) and REPRO 2 asserts the buggy behavior as expected. It should not be counted as repo test evidence. Target and workspace were not modified; verification ran in `/tmp/opencode/upgo-verify`.
